verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents conversational interfaces that answer questions grounded in your indexed content (docs-1, docs-45), which is a form of AI-generated answers from your data. However, this is an API-level retrieval/answer feature for building end-user experiences, not in-product AI insights or suggestions. Its analytics (docs-9) track queries and conversions but are not described as AI-generated, and the MCP server routes AI interaction through external clients. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations about the data, AI suggestions in the dashboard or analytics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational answers.
